production_inspect.note: Pending: no read-only production inspect has been run for SQL 87. The production pre-state is not code-derived (the restored resolve_check_case may differ from migration 20260826125804, its owner and ACL are unknown, anon and service_role may or may not exist), so expected_live_definition_sha256 is null and evaluate and apply refuse. Run node scripts/deployment-guard/sql87-resolve-check-case-tenant-scope-production-apply.mjs --inspect on the runner and record its date, SSM command id, source commit, live_definition_sha256, function_states, functions (arguments, owner, security definer, proacl), case_owner, case_triggers, precondition_failures and apply_preconditions_met here, and copy live_definition_sha256 into expected_live_definition_sha256, in the reviewed change that sets execute true. If precondition_failures is not [] (a missing prerequisite, another signature, result type or parameter names, a function owned by another role, a resolve_check_case ACL entry the file does not revoke, or case_owner.case_owner_safe false: the helper and the two case trigger functions with different owners, a trigger function that is not SECURITY DEFINER, or an owner that is or belongs to checksops / authenticated / anon / service_role without being superuser, which the file refuses with case_owner_unsafe), stop: that needs its own reviewed change.

intended_post_state.note: After the unchanged SQL 87 file run as checksops_admin: resolve_check_case is the reviewed definition (tenant-scoped lookups, PR #991's claim-belongs-to-tenant rule, no claim data from outside the tenant), owned by checksops_admin, SECURITY DEFINER with search_path=public, and EXECUTE for its owner only (PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role and checksops revoked); tg_check_intake_assign_case and tg_loss_draft_assign_case are unchanged, SECURITY DEFINER and owned by the same role, so the triggers keep calling it. intended_replacement_sha256 equals the staging pin's. function_owner is the expected production login (as for SQL 72 to 86); the first inspect must confirm it.
